ceased_on.description: The day they ceased to be a controller.

central_register_on.description: The day ACRA's central register was updated: within 2 business days after the company's.

company_register_on.description: The day they were entered in the company's register of registrable controllers: within 7 days.

controller.description: true: a registrable controller; false: found not to be one, with the reason, such as rights that do not confer control.

grounds.description: A controller's grounds, each once; none for a holder who is not one.

items.description: shares or votes: more than 25% of them; board: the right to appoint or remove directors holding a majority of the board's votes; influence: significant influence or control.

notices.description: The yearly notices sent and the replies, oldest first.

reason.description: Why a holder is not a controller, as the company secretary concluded.
examples: The consent matters protect the investment and do not direct the company

since.description: The day they became a controller, or the day of the conclusion that they are not.
